rules.title: Motion to study a ban on algorithmic rent-setting software (CF 24-1031)
rules.requirement: This is only a proposal. It asks the Los Angeles Housing Department to report on how many landlords use algorithm-based software to set rents and whether a ban is feasible. No ban is in effect under this motion.
rules.key_value: LAHD report on feasibility of banning algorithmic rent-setting software
rules.coverage_conditions: Would concern rental housing in the City of Los Angeles. The motion states no building-type limits.
rules.reason: Only one candidate: an official council motion asking for a feasibility report, so it stays a pending proposal.
